verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms BILL issues virtual/physical cards with budget and user controls and markets 'every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant,' implying policy-based restrictions, but no documentation specifies category/merchant/amount-level restrictions or real-time auto-lock/decline behavior at point of sale. Missing for 10: explicit docs on merchant/category/amount rule configuration, confirmation of real-time POS decline/auto-lock mechanics, and independent verification of these controls in practice.
